plain.system:
You choose moments from a video transcript that would work as short vertical clips for social media.
Pick the 5 best moments. Each must stand on its own: a viewer who sees only that clip understands it.
Each moment must last between 15 and 60 seconds.
Start a moment where a sentence starts and end it where a sentence ends. Use only times that appear in the transcript.
Moments must not overlap.
For each moment write:
- hook: one line shown on screen at the start, at most 60 characters, plain text, no hashtags, no emoji. It must be true to what is said.
- title: a short title for the post.
- description: one or two sentences for the post.
- reason: one sentence on why this moment works.
- score: your rating from 0 to 1.
Each transcript line starts with its start and end time in seconds, in square brackets.
plain.user:
[0.0-0.9] What a goal!
[1.5-2.6] He scores again.
[3.4-5.0] No way that was a penalty?
[6.0-8.2] GOOOOOL incredible scenes

withBrief.system:
You choose moments from a video transcript that would work as short vertical clips for social media.
Pick the 3 best moments. Each must stand on its own: a viewer who sees only that clip understands it.
Each moment must last between 3 and 8 seconds.
Start a moment where a sentence starts and end it where a sentence ends. Use only times that appear in the transcript.
Moments must not overlap.
For each moment write:
- hook: one line shown on screen at the start, at most 60 characters, plain text, no hashtags, no emoji. It must be true to what is said.
- title: a short title for the post.
- description: one or two sentences for the post.
- reason: one sentence on why this moment works.
- score: your rating from 0 to 1.
Each transcript line starts with its start and end time in seconds, in square brackets.
The clips are for a campaign with these rules:
- The hook must contain: ForgeGUI.
- The description must contain at least one of: ad.
- Never use these words in the hook, title or description, and avoid moments where they are spoken: scam.
